```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
begin
  api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
  client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
  result = client.speech_async(LiterLlm::CreateSpeechRequest.new(input: 'Hello', model: 'tts-1', voice: 'alloy'))
rescue StandardError => error
```
